requirements.clause: BranchRequestV1 binds sourceThreadId, immutable sourceCut, nativeCheckpointRef|null, requestedModelBinding, intent INSPECT|FORK_CONVERSATION; START_NEW_WITH_QUOTE is a separate intent and never a native fork; new live work uses new thread/run identity and fresh authorization
requirements.reason: branchRequestV1Schema + applyBranchCommand implement all three intents; FORK_CONVERSATION refuses without tested adapter API; START_NEW_WITH_QUOTE allocates a fresh thread and stores immutable lineage. Verified by session-branch-v3 tests.

requirements.clause: ArchiveV1 JSON format: version=1, sourceProduct, exportedAt, conversations[], provenance, importWarnings; message fields id/parentId/role/text/sourceTimestamp/attachmentRefs; imported system/tool text is historical untrusted content only
requirements.reason: archiveV1DocumentSchema is strict; decodeArchiveBytes/validateArchiveSemantics enforce every field before publication; system/tool roles persist as display text only.

requirements.clause: HistoricalCursorV1 binds owner, source session, snapshot upper sequence, filters and schema version; fork ability is SUPPORTED|UNSUPPORTED|UNPROVEN never inferred from UI timeline
requirements.reason: historicalCursorV1Schema + HMAC-signed cursor in SessionBranchReadModels bind owner/cut/schema; M14_ADAPTER_CAPABILITIES reports per-adapter UNPROVEN fork status independent of the timeline.

requirements.clause: Adapter capability matrix for read history, fixed-cut inspect and native fork; test each actual implementation; text transcript export does not prove fork
requirements.reason: M14_ADAPTER_CAPABILITIES enumerates hermes/pi/official-claude/official-gemini/official-cursor: receiptHistory=true (source-inspected RuntimeAdapter.history), fixedCutInspect=UNSUPPORTED, nativeFork=UNPROVEN. No adapter exposes a tested fork API in this tree.

requirements.clause: Read-only historical view with snapshot-bound pagination; new events do not move the upper cut; archived/missing attachments and incomplete source coverage shown explicitly
requirements.reason: captureSession freezes a bounded message copy at store.sequence; captureMessages pages the frozen rows; coverage/truncated/incompleteSource (TRUNCATED_HISTORY, NATIVE_TRANSCRIPT_UNAVAILABLE, ATTACHMENTS_NOT_CAPTURED) are recorded explicitly.

requirements.clause: Actual native fork uses source engine's tested API, new thread/run/epoch, account custody, revalidated binding; never silently reuse a session file
requirements.reason: HOLD_NATIVE_FORK: no adapter in this tree exposes a tested native fork API; RuntimeAdapter.history returns receipt IDs only. FORK_CONVERSATION returns FORK_UNSUPPORTED and creates nothing.

requirements.clause: When native forking is unsupported: Inspect archive or Start new task with selected quoted context; label the latter as a new task, never exact replay; never rewrite native history from projected UI messages
requirements.reason: START_NEW_WITH_QUOTE creates an ordinary new thread titled 'New task (quoted context)' with quoted excerpts stored as immutable lineage; the UI labels it a new task and explains files do not change.

requirements.clause: Previous tool calls stay inert historical observations; no branch operation replays shell commands, reinstates approvals or reverses remote effects; branch does not auto-restore files
requirements.reason: Neither capture, branch nor import writes operation/resource/toolEffect/workspaceCheckpoint/checkpoint/editJournal/outbox entities or calls runtime.start/compact. Asserted by dedicated store-entity and mock-call checks.

requirements.clause: M08 file checkpoint review connects only through a separate Restore files action and approval; never combined with conversation changes into one opaque undo
requirements.reason: Session-branch contracts and UI carry no restore-files path; the menu renders Restore files as a distinct control only when the file-checkpoint capability is present. M08 keeps its own approval flow unchanged.

requirements.clause: ArchiveV1 UTF-8 JSON importer only: reject >20 MiB before parse, >100 conversations, >10,000 messages; unique conversation/message IDs, same-conversation parents, acyclic iterative graph check; validate all before publishing
requirements.reason: decodeArchiveBytes enforces the byte gate before JSON.parse; validateArchiveSemantics performs iterative cycle detection and all graph checks pre-publication; publication is one atomic Store command. D01/D02 assert edges and atomicity.

requirements.clause: No external-product parser admitted: reject ZIP/gzip/binary/extraction as UNSUPPORTED_IMPORT_FORMAT; never claim DeepSeek/Codex support; never open attachment paths or fetch URLs
requirements.reason: Magic-byte checks reject ZIP/gzip/UTF-16 pre-parse; attachmentRefs are validated as opaque inert identifiers and never dereferenced. External format support remains HOLD_EXTERNAL_FORMAT pending a pinned parser manifest.

requirements.clause: Render imported text literally; preview reports secret-bearing fields and access-bearing links without dereferencing; block publication of secret-classified fields; heuristic caveat; show source/counts/warnings/destination; never promote to project memory
requirements.reason: scanForSensitiveContent reports secretFields (commit blocked with IMPORT_SECRET_CONTENT) and accessLinks without fetching; preview returns counts/warnings/destination + IMPORT_PREVIEW_HEURISTIC_NOTE; no memory-write path exists in import.

requirements.clause: Deterministic source digest/deduplication and immutable provenance; cancellation leaves no half-active conversation; staged artifacts finalized or cleaned under exact staging identity
requirements.reason: digestKey dedupes per owner scope inside one Store transaction; cancel removes only the staging importId pre-commit and returns the committed receipt post-commit. D03 asserts both branches.

requirements.clause: Branch after compaction, archive, account revocation and source removal; unresolved source pointers stay unavailable; never invent replacement evidence
requirements.reason: SessionBranchReadModels.sourceThread re-fences capture reads against current thread ownership: account revocation and thread removal both yield CAPABILITY_DENIED with no substituted content.

requirements.clause: History view exposes Inspect point, Fork conversation where supported, and Start new task with quoted context as distinct actions; each explains whether files change
requirements.reason: SessionBranchMenu renders three distinct actions; fork is hidden/disabled while capability is UNPROVEN with an explicit unsupported note; each action states files are unchanged.

requirements.clause: Branch header names parent and source cut; tool effects marked historical and cannot be replayed by clicking
requirements.reason: SessionBranchLineage renders parent thread + source cut (sequence, message count); capture/imported messages render as static historical text with no replay control.

requirements.clause: Import preview lists format support, warnings, omitted attachments and destination; Imported archive badge persists until an explicit new live task
requirements.reason: stageImport returns format/counts/warnings/omittedAttachments/destination; the menu shows them pre-commit and renders a persistent 'Imported archive' badge on imported conversations.

requirements.clause: Paging while new events arrive preserves the fixed cut with no cross-owner records
requirements.reason: Covered by 'captures an owner-bound frozen view that new events never move' — messages added after the cut and a cross-thread message never appear.

requirements.clause: Unsupported native fork never produces an apparent exact continuation; account mismatch and revoked source refuse live fork
requirements.reason: FORK_CONVERSATION always returns FORK_UNSUPPORTED without creating threads/branches; the account-mismatch case yields the same refusal; no continuation artifact exists.

requirements.clause: Branch/import cannot execute tools, restore old approvals or change files
requirements.reason: D04 plus the branch-authority test assert zero operations/resources/grants/memory writes and no runtime.start/compact calls across capture, quote-task and import.

requirements.clause: Duplicate/cyclic IDs, traversal paths, symlinks, oversized archive and malformed attachments fail before publication
requirements.reason: Attachment ref validation rejects traversal/absolute/URL forms; D01/D02 cover size and graph rejection before any publish.

requirements.clause: Import cancellation and repeated import digest are deterministic; memory is not silently populated
requirements.reason: D03 covers cancel-before/after-commit; dedup test asserts identical digest returns the same receipt; D04 asserts zero memory writes.

requirements.clause: Conversation fork leaves M08 file state unchanged until separately approved restore
requirements.reason: Branch-authority test asserts no workspaceCheckpoint/checkpoint/editJournal entities are created by any branch intent.

requirements.clause: Read-only inspection passes independently of native fork; each adapter's fork capability requires runtime proof; imported archives never inherit executable authority
requirements.reason: INSPECT works while FORK_CONVERSATION stays UNSUPPORTED; imports persist inert records only — verified by zero-effect assertions.

requirements.clause: Host-owned flags sessions.branchV1 and sessions.inertImportV1 default false; not in strict UI preferences; agents/plugins cannot enable; each sub-capability needs own proof
requirements.reason: Both keys registered default-false in the central owner registry (not user preferences, not plugin/agent writable); every command enforces its flag at the host boundary; tests inject via __setCapabilityFlagForTests only.

requirements.clause: Rollback: disable creation/import while preserving immutable parent/child and archive provenance; no source-session deletion or external-effect reversal
requirements.reason: Flag-off denies new commands while persisted captures/branches/imports remain readable evidence; nothing deletes source sessions or reverses effects.

requirements.clause: 20 MiB admitted; 20 MiB+1 rejected before JSON parsing; 100 conversations and 10,000 messages are maxima
requirements.reason: Exact decision case implemented: at-limit bytes reach validation (typed format error), +1 yields IMPORT_TOO_LARGE pre-parse, both count maxima admitted and +1 rejected.

requirements.clause: Duplicate message IDs, cross-conversation parents and cycles reject the whole import; no published conversation exists
requirements.reason: it.each covers all five graph violations through the real stage command; zero importedConversation/importReceipt/importStaging remain.

requirements.clause: Cancel before publish leaves no active records; cancel after returns the original committed receipt; never half-public data
requirements.reason: Decision test exercises both orderings through service.command; assertions cover staging removal, committed receipt identity and no half-public records.

requirements.clause: Imported system/tool command text leaves executor, grant-creation and memory-write counters at zero
requirements.reason: Archive embeds shell/command-shaped system+tool text; after commit all operation/resource/taskMemory entities remain empty and runtime.start/followUp/compact stay uncalled.

requirements.clause: Provider with history export but no tested fork returns UNSUPPORTED; quoted-context creation is explicitly a separate new task
requirements.reason: adapterForkCapability() is UNPROVEN with receipt-history-only adapters; FORK_CONVERSATION refuses while START_NEW_WITH_QUOTE creates a distinct labeled thread.

requirements.clause: C4 actual native fork — requires a named adapter fork API with platform proof
requirements.reason: HOLD_NATIVE_FORK: source inspection of the five RuntimeAdapter implementations shows no fork/branch/forkSession API; RuntimeAdapter.history returns receipt IDs. Fork stays UNSUPPORTED.

requirements.clause: C5 external format parsers (ZIP, DeepSeek export, raw Codex/Pi directories) — unadmitted by this revision
requirements.reason: HOLD_EXTERNAL_FORMAT: only strict ArchiveV1 JSON is admitted; other formats are rejected as UNSUPPORTED_IMPORT_FORMAT pending an exact parser manifest.

requirements.clause: Mutable-only history cannot back a native continuation
requirements.reason: HOLD_IMMUTABLE_SOURCE applies to the native-fork path: projected UI messages and receipt IDs are not an immutable native transcript, so Inspect uses a host-copied frozen view instead.
